name: vantovault-duplex-buyers-atlas
title: VanToVault Duplex Buyers Atlas: Owner-Occupant 2-4 Unit Purchase Loans by Metro, 2018-2025
description: Mortgages used to buy a 2-, 3- or 4-unit home that the borrower said would be their principal residence, counted from the public HMDA loan-level data (action_taken=1, total_units=2-4, occupancy_type=1, loan_purpose=1, lien_status=1). National series 2018-2025 and a metro (MSA/MD) panel with unit count, loan type, income, loan amount, rate, combined LTV and borrower demographic counts. Cells of 1-9 loans are blank; metro-years under 50 loans are three-year totals.

sources.title: FFIEC / CFPB, Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) public loan-level data, 2018-2025, via the HMDA Data Browser API

citation: Van to Vault (2026). VanToVault Duplex Buyers Atlas: Owner-Occupant 2-4 Unit Purchase Loans by Metro, 2018-2025 (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. VanToVault. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23003737

suppression.cell_rule: Count cells with 1-9 loans are blank. Zeros are retained.
suppression.metro_rule: Metro-years under 50 qualifying loans are reported as 3-year totals; medians are null on those rows because medians are not additive.

limitations: Cash purchases never appear in HMDA.
Lenders below HMDA reporting thresholds do not report.
Occupancy is borrower-stated at application and is not verified.
Loan amounts are HMDA public bin midpoints, so medians are approximate.
Interest rate and income are missing for some loans; denominators are provided.
This data cannot show approval odds or pricing fairness.
